notes: Catalog covers test classes and shared fixture hashes; updating source requires explicit classification review.
Fresh process isolation does not clear persisted residues, databases or preferences.
No group is a data-preservation certification. Omitted tests and unmatched assumptions remain pending.
Supervised marker-based harnesses are plan-only; they cannot be silently added to an unattended group.

app-rendering.fixture_state: No beta fixture activated by these test classes; Compose/fake repositories. Existing QA may be started.
hazards: QA process stop/restart; test UI and isolated preferences may change.

app-storage.fixture_state: Disposable QA context; test databases, files and preferences are created/deleted.
hazards: Test data/files/preferences are mutated; review fixtures before using a populated QA.

app-backup.fixture_state: Isolated backup, files and portable preference fixtures.
hazards: Restore/recovery and filesystem mutations inside test fixtures; never a preservation run on personal QA.

app-system.fixture_state: Existing QA and controlled widget/weather/notification objects.
hazards: System-facing widget, scheduler, permission or notification APIs; QA state can change.

database.fixture_state: Separate database.test package; synthetic Room databases.
hazards: Creates, migrates, replaces and deletes test databases; not the application database.

beta-isolated.fixture_state: Private synthetic beta stores/keys, not a public server.
hazards: Creates and removes isolated beta/backup test files and Keystore aliases.

beta-cold-process.fixture_state: Two ordered methods in independent processes: prepare durable synthetic pending feedback, then reopen.
hazards: Creates synthetic files and Keystore identity; second method cleans its own fixture; interruption can leave fixture data.

existing-session.fixture_state: Preserve owner session; open and closed cases may skip depending on current state.
hazards: Starts/recreates QA activities; no automatic session creation; skips remain pending.

notifications-alarm.fixture_state: Public root, disposable QA; exact alarms require specific device/real-alarm authorization.
hazards: Before each method clears QA data; may emit real exact alarms and notifications; requires separate specific alarm authorization. No permission is granted by runner.

updates-signed-fixture.fixture_state: Previously supplied, explicitly authorized signed APK fixture at updates28-fixtures.
hazards: Reads supplied fixture, creates/deletes isolated temporary files; runner does not upload fixtures.

updates-temporary-session.fixture_state: Existing public QA work/onboarding session, owner lock open; no beta activation, file or identity mutation. Restores previous runtime pause state.
hazards: Starts/recreates activities, pauses and restores local runtimes, writes safe QA-only evidence; preserves labor/preferences.
updates-temporary-session.manual_only: Requires operator-approved existing QA session and private preservation/evidence review; no automatic fixture repair.

support-browser-supervised.fixture_state: Includes closed/existing cases plus temporary session for real browser review.
hazards: Real external browser and Activity navigation; operator reviews return and supplies continuation marker. No beta activation or identity changes.
support-browser-supervised.manual_only: SupportMenuActivityTest waits for an operator marker during real browser review. Use its explicitly authorized supervised procedure; this runner does not write private continuation files or claim human review.

credits-supervised.fixture_state: Public root; existing QA preserved, synthetic presenter events and supervised Main navigation; requires existing completed setup/onboarding and owner-unlocked access.
hazards: Requires no active QA Activities/widgets/notifications and compatible channels; preserves owner data, including existing beta residue files.
MAIN must verify cleanup-complete and stop QA before leaving the device; do not remove beta residue files.
credits-supervised.manual_only: Supervised preservation, cleanup-complete verification and final QA stop are mandatory; not an unattended fixture. No beta-file cleanup is permitted.

updates-oem-supervised.fixture_state: Public root; synthetic writer-only bytes through actual OEM SAF, not PackageManager validation. QA public incompatibility checked separately.
hazards: Operator creates a NEW disposable external document and records exact provider/path; private fixture source/delegate restored by test, external cleanup explicit.
updates-oem-supervised.manual_only: UpdatesOemSafActivityTest requires an operator save marker and OEM UI review. This runner does not automate private markers or human save/cleanup decisions.

app-public-fixtures.fixture_state: Public application root; disposable labor/onboarding/widget fixtures, no beta activation.
hazards: May clear QA tables and change preferences/widget/notification state; disposable authorization remains mandatory.

public-root.fixture_state: Real public root and recreation; preserved beta residues do not grant or deny access.
hazards: Starts/recreates QA activities and local runtimes; no beta records/identity created or erased.

hours-restoration-race.fixture_state: Real Main/ViewModel with in-memory repositories; explicit QA emulator opt-in. No Activity or database fixture.
hazards: QA Application starts normally; use the authorized disposable emulator only.

upgrade-backup-preparation.fixture_state: Opt-in synthetic full V6 backup export and isolated restore, only the exact authorized disposable API33 AVD. No Release sandbox writes.
hazards: Creates two isolated QA databases, synthetic photo and preferences; retains only a private backup and hash/count evidence.
Requires operator identity/date arguments and strict live QA file preservation. Never restore this backup after the installed upgrade baseline.
upgrade-backup-preparation.manual_only: Verify the named API33 AVD and runtime identity, supply explicit fixture consent/date, inspect successful isolated round-trip and live QA preservation before exporting. No automatic data preparation or signed-app mutation.

public-cold-root.fixture_state: Prepare exactly one residual state in fresh disposable QA, then verifyAfterExplicitProcessDeath in another process. Signed test receipts are inert; no Application beta activation.
hazards: Writes historical beta preference fixture and hash-only cache evidence; requires fresh disposable data for each state.
Explicit force-stop between selected methods; preserves residues for inspection. No device operation performed by catalog check.
public-cold-root.manual_only: Select exactly one prepare method, stop QA explicitly, then verify method. Never execute the whole class.
